pages.text: Leonard is available through his spawn egg or /summon bewitchment:leonard. Conjure Leonard now provides ritual access. This greater demon has 500 health, strong armor, fire and fall immunity, and resistance to harmful effects. He persists at distance and carries his wand. His red boss bar is hidden from players pledged to him.

To pledge to a spawned Leonard, wear a full Alchemist, Besmirched, Green Witch or Witches set, hold a Green Candle offhand and eat Stew of the Grotesque within eight horizontal and five vertical blocks. The nearest living pledgeable boss is selected. The candle is retained. The pledge protects you from Leonard and Cambion target selection. Hurting Leonard revokes it.

A pledged player with at least two experience levels can use a main-hand bowl on Leonard to receive stew when his cooldown is clear. Levels are checked but not deducted, matching the original. One bowl is consumed; other bowls are retained instead of replacing the entire stack. The cooldown is 24000 loaded ticks per Leonard and saves with him.

Leonard periodically regenerates and gains resistance when wounded. Every 450 ticks he refreshes Strength II, Resistance II and Speed II during a six-tick burst. He launches small fireballs at player targets farther than four blocks during six ticks of each hundred-tick cycle, except while buffing. His melee attempt gives players three seconds of Magic Weakness.

Below one-quarter health, Leonard applies five minutes of Mortal Coil to his current target unless it already has the effect. On the final tick, Mortal Coil deals a huge magic hit through normal damage handling. Removing the effect prevents that hit. Leonard's death clears Mortal Coil from players in a sixteen-block cube around him. Nearby unrelated Mortal Coil effects are also removed, matching legacy behavior.

Leonard drops one wand and one Demon Heart through his loot table, and awards 165 base XP. His original geometry and texture are restored with mapped biped animation and a held-wand layer. Underwater breathing replaces the original air-counter quirk. Nearby pledged Leonards grant brewing bonuses at the first bottle. $(l:sympathy/tarot)Taglock Tarot$() can report whether a player has either greater-demon pledge; it does not name the patron. Combat, rendering, bowl use and pledge acquisition need live testing.
